WITH per AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) tot
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT CustomerID, tot
FROM per
WHERE tot = (SELECT MIN(tot) FROM per)
ORDER BY CustomerID;
